q_A: SELECT name , tonnage FROM ship ORDER BY name DESC
gold_q_B: SELECT "ship"."name" AS "name", "ship"."heaviness" AS "tonnage" FROM "ship" AS "ship" ORDER BY "name" DESC

q_A: SELECT T1.killed , T1.injured FROM death AS T1 JOIN ship AS t2 ON T1.caused_by_ship_id = T2.id WHERE T2.tonnage = 't'
gold_q_B: SELECT "t1"."killed" AS "killed", "t1"."injured" AS "injured" FROM "death" AS "t1" JOIN "ship" AS "t2" ON "t1"."caused_by_ship_id" = "t2"."id" WHERE "t2"."heaviness" = 't'

q_A: SELECT count(*) FROM battle WHERE id NOT IN ( SELECT lost_in_battle FROM ship WHERE tonnage = '225' )
gold_q_B: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "_col_0" FROM "battle" AS "battle" WHERE NOT "battle"."id" IN (SELECT "ship"."lost_in_battle" AS "lost_in_battle" FROM "ship" AS "ship" WHERE "ship"."heaviness" = '225')
